title: Dexcom G6 issues with Android 10 Pixel 4
symptom: The user tried to run the setup wizard on the Dexcom G6 and had issues connecting. After disabling Trust Auto Connect and OB1 Collector, it bonded, but the app does not utilize the calibration code and requires manual calibrations, behaving like a G5. Another user reports the sensor keeps rejecting calibrations, and another has connection drops after a few missed readings.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. One user found that turning off Allow Ob1 Unbonding fixed the issue, but another user suggests it might be a battery saving measure interfering with repeated BLE connections.
fix: One user confirmed that turning off Allow Ob1 Unbonding fixed the issue. Another user found that setting Bluetooth AVRCP to version 1.3 in developer settings helped with reconnection reliability, but it is not a final solution.
evidence_quote: Confirmed turning off Allow Ob1 Unbonding fixed the issue for me. Xdrip works with the G6 code with no issues now.
